scope: Bounded local ECMAScript execution backend only. This inventory is not a claim of RegexBuddy parity or delivered interface behavior.

reference.versionStatus: Not independently established from the reviewed online manual.
reference.inventoryMethod: All distinct manual HTML topic URLs linked by the official table of contents and keyword index, including topics found only in the keyword index. Each topic page was retrieved and hashed.
reference.limitation: This is the online user-guide topic inventory, not a claim to inventory every page in the separately published PDF syntax tutorial/reference. Syntax and reference expansion remain unfinished.

engine.name: ECMAScript RegExp
engine.binding: Current browser module Worker, with runtime build string and feature probes returned by capabilities. JavaScript and Unicode engine versions are not exposed and remain unknown.

otherEngines.reason: No PCRE, .NET, Python, Java or other engine is executed by this backend.

engine.positions: UTF-16 code-unit offsets, end-exclusive; unmatched captures and indices are null.
engine.flags: d g i m s u v y are recognized; runtime support is probed, duplicates and incompatible u/v combinations are rejected.
engine.privacy: No network, eval, payload logging or persistence in the module. The caller owns interface state.

verification.localNodeWorkerTests: Passed; uses an explicitly identified Node adapter and does not establish browser-engine or interface proof.

limitations: No debugger execution trace or fabricated backtracking steps.
No other-engine execution, conversion or equivalence promise.
No complete syntax explanation, code generation, templates, expression libraries or folder search supplied by this module.
Elapsed timeout includes Worker startup; the browser event loop must schedule the termination callback.
Worker termination bounds blocking of the caller; it is not a hard operating-system memory quota.
